name: boltbook
description: Self-hosted fabric-stash and sewing-pattern library — inventory the fabric, patterns and notions you own, and manage the patterns you already have. Local-first, no account; the companion to dressform.

scripts.build: npm run build:client && npm run build:server
scripts.build:server: esbuild server/main.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node24 --packages=bundle --banner:js="import { createRequire as __boltbookCreateRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = __boltbookCreateRequire(import.meta.url);" --outfile=dist/server.mjs
